caption: The new account opened in an AI wizard that had already made five designs, all five selected to publish.
The catalog shows two prices per product, for example the Accent Coffee Mug from USD 6.40, or USD 4.71 with Printify Premium.
Our 1000 by 720 test image on the mug got the warning Medium resolution (187 DPI).
The product menu offers Replace, Copy to, Set personalization and Delete. We found no export of the product data; the account email is hidden.
Opening the product brought a pop-up for AI optimized listings. We clicked Opt-out.
Listing details after the opt-out: our test title and description, while the listing already had 40 mockups, 16 tags and a price of $11.99 to $16.99.
The mockup library: 40 mockups selected for the listing, with a Select all option.
Both test mugs saved on the free plan without a card or a connected store, and both are Unpublished; the account email is hidden.
